summary: Akamai Technologies filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $3.5 billion convertible note offering: $1.75 billion in 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030 and $1.75 billion in 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032, sold in a private placement to QIBs under Rule 144A. Net proceeds partially funded a $236.6 million convertible note hedge (offset by warrant proceeds) and a $350 million share repurchase of 2,476,298 shares. Remaining proceeds will fund accelerated CIS capital expenditures. Notes are senior unsecured obligations. The simultaneous debt issuance and stock buyback represent a capital return to shareholders via leverage. Watch for dilution impact from potential conversion and any rating agency actions.
